product_overview: Raj's Cafe is a Next.js-based frontend that lets customers browse menu items, manage a cart, authenticate, place orders, and interact with cafe content and services. It also supports reservations, contact submissions, and promotional pages like loyalty, blog, brew guides, and quizzes.
core_goals: Provide a polished cafe browsing experience with home, menu, and content pages.
Enable user authentication via JWT-backed login and registration.
Support cart management and checkout flows for ordering.
Allow customers to submit reservations and contact requests through API-backed forms.
Offer informational and engagement pages such as blog, loyalty, FAQ, testimonials, and quizzes.

features.name: Home Page
features.description: Landing experience with branding, cafe story, menu preview, loyalty/newsletter, reservation form, location/map, navigation, and footer.
user_flows: GET / -> Receive home page with hero, about, menu preview, and reservation sections -> User submits reservation form -> POST /api/reservation with valid reservation details -> Receive 200 confirmation
GET / -> Receive home page content -> User submits reservation form with missing or invalid fields -> POST /api/reservation with invalid payload -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Login and signup flows backed by JWT authentication and localStorage session persistence.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with name, email, phone, and password -> Receive 201 with user object and JWT token -> Store cafe_token and cafe_user in localStorage -> User is authenticated in the app
POST /api/auth/login with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with user object and JWT token -> Store cafe_token and cafe_user in localStorage -> Access protected pages such as /orders
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> Show login failure message to the user
POST /api/auth/register with duplicate email or invalid registration data -> Receive 400 or 409 error -> Show registration validation message

features.name: Menu System
features.description: Full menu browsing with category filtering and dynamic menu item detail pages.
user_flows: GET /menu -> Receive full menu page with category filters -> User selects a category -> GET /menu/[slug] for a specific item -> Receive item detail page
GET /menu -> Receive menu page content -> User requests a non-existent item -> GET /menu/[slug] with invalid slug -> Receive not-found or error state

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: Cart management with add, remove, and quantity update actions persisted through cart state.
user_flows: GET /menu/[slug] -> Receive menu item details -> User adds item to cart -> POST/Client cart action updates CartContext -> GET /cart -> Receive updated cart with item and quantity
GET /cart -> Receive cart contents -> User removes an item or updates quantity to zero -> Client cart action updates CartContext -> Receive empty cart or reduced item count
GET /cart with no items -> Receive empty cart state -> User attempts checkout with empty cart -> Redirect or error shown -> No order is placed

features.name: Checkout & Orders
features.description: Checkout page for placing orders and authenticated order history/tracking page.
user_flows: GET /cart with items -> User proceeds to checkout -> GET /checkout -> Receive checkout page -> User completes order submission -> Receive order confirmation
GET /orders with valid JWT token -> AuthGate allows access -> Fetch order history/tracking data -> Receive order list and status updates
GET /orders without JWT token -> AuthGate blocks access -> Redirect to /login or show unauthorized state -> Order history is not displayed

features.name: Content Pages
features.description: Informational and engagement pages including blog, brewing guides, gift cards, FAQ, loyalty, quiz, and testimonials.
user_flows: GET /blog -> Receive article listing and stories -> User opens a blog article -> Receive selected article content
GET /brew-guide -> Receive brewing tutorial content -> User navigates through guide sections -> Receive detailed brewing instructions
GET /faq -> Receive FAQ accordion content -> User expands a question -> Receive answer content
GET /testimonials -> Receive customer review content -> User browses testimonials -> Receive testimonial details
GET /quiz -> Receive quiz questions -> User submits answers -> Receive coffee recommendation results
GET /gift -> Receive gift card page -> User views gift card options -> Receive available denominations and purchase info

features.name: Reservation System
features.description: Reservation form submission backed by the server-side reservation API route.
user_flows: GET / -> Receive reservation form section -> User enters reservation details -> POST /api/reservation with valid data -> Receive 200 success response
GET / -> Receive reservation form section -> User submits incomplete reservation details -> POST /api/reservation with invalid data -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Contact form submission backed by the server-side contact API route.
user_flows: User submits contact form on supported page -> POST /api/contact with valid name, email, and message -> Receive 200 success confirmation
User submits contact form with missing required fields -> POST /api/contact with invalid payload -> Receive 400 validation error
